takeaway: Rigid climatological corrections explain only a small fraction of residual variance (< 0.25%).
Annual harmonic phase and GEBCO depth contain substantial predictive information (+4.94% RMSE, +6.49% MAE).
Distance to coast and ocean fraction do not provide incremental skill once depth is present.
Small incremental gain (+0.93%) over weak baseline without depth, but below the 1.00% threshold.
Spatial context does not outperform tabular core once depth is included; bathymetry captures key spatial structure.
Heterogeneous skill: model degrades when B0 is already close to MUR, with peak gains at intermediate-high |R|.
Prospective discrimination of large residual events is weak and insufficient for an operational gating strategy.
True residual field exhibits short-lag persistence, motivating causal temporal experiments in D32.
